name: Three Fingers
blurb: A 1930s fire lookout on top of the south finger, reached by ladders, with Puget Sound and the Olympics spread out to the west.
permit: Tupso Pass Road (FR 41) is washed out and closed to vehicles miles below the trailhead: plan on a long road walk or a bike. Northwest Forest Pass. Free self-issued wilderness permit.

routes.name: Goat Flat
routes.summary: Trail past Saddle Lake to the heather meadows of Goat Flat, along the ridge to Tin Can Gap, across a snowfield and up rock and wooden ladders to the lookout. The road closure adds miles each way.
skills: Long days with an overnight pack
Ice-axe self-arrest on a steep snowfield

waypoints.name: Goat Flat
waypoints.note: Open heather meadows and the best camping on the route. Use established sites.

sections.note: Rooty, often muddy trail to Saddle Lake.
Up through forest to the meadows of Goat Flat.
